projects.title: AI Product Catalog Automation
projects.tagline: Structured catalog enrichment with AI-assisted workflows
projects.description: An application workflow exploring product categorization, product-data enrichment, and extraction of structured attributes from catalog information and imagery.

projects.title: Shopify & WordPress Product Synchronization
projects.tagline: Modernizing a product-sync service from VB.NET to Python
projects.description: A product and inventory synchronization service connecting e-commerce platforms and vendor data. The work includes moving established synchronization logic from a VB.NET application into Python, improving the service structure, and developing a frontend to manage and monitor synchronization workflows. Public-facing examples use fictional store and product data.

projects.title: Product Pricing Automation
projects.tagline: Rule-based pricing calculations and repeatable pricing workflows
projects.description: A pricing workflow that applies configurable product attributes and calculation rules to generate consistent prices, with a focus on traceable logic and maintainable configuration.

projects.title: Inventory & Vendor Synchronization
projects.tagline: Normalize vendor feeds and reconcile product data
projects.description: Data synchronization workflows for vendor catalogs and inventory feeds, including normalization, SKU matching, filtering, and updates across connected systems.

projects.title: Shipping Rate & Carrier Integrations
projects.tagline: Connect shipping services to an e-commerce checkout
projects.description: Shipping integration work covering carrier rate requests, package quantities, unit normalization, rate selection, and clear checkout feedback in a WordPress/WooCommerce environment.

projects.title: Customer Messaging & Workflow Automation
projects.tagline: Connect messaging workflows with operational data
projects.description: Customer communication workflows that integrate messaging services with application data, supporting message handling, status tracking, and operational automation.

process.title: Understand
